title: Loose Thread
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
I picked a random topic
Pulled a thread from the drawer
Old matchbook, broken buckle
Found a map on the floor
You laughed like you knew me
From a town I never named
Now the room feels smaller
Since I said your face

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin it again
Let it land
Any small thing
In my hand

[Chorus]
Any random topic
You and me, we make it shine
Any random topic
You say yours, I’ll say mine
Little spark, big motion
Right here, all at once
Any random topic
And it turns into us

[Verse 2]
Café receipt on the table
Folded like a paper boat
Your blue pen in my pocket
Got me writing what I know
One more stupid question
And the ceiling starts to sway
Funny how a nothing
Keeps the dark away

[Pre-Chorus]
Spin it again
Let it land
Any small thing
In my hand

[Chorus]
Any random topic
You and me, we make it shine
Any random topic
You say yours, I’ll say mine
Little spark, big motion
Right here, all at once
Any random topic
And it turns into us

[Bridge]
Talk to me about rain boots
About the stain on your sleeve
About the train that never showed up
About the place you’d leave
I’ll follow every crooked line
Till the whole thing clicks
One small thing can open
Everything like this

[Chorus]
Any random topic
You and me, we make it shine
Any random topic
You say yours, I’ll say mine
Little spark, big motion
Right here, all at once
Any random topic
And it turns into us
